title: Smart Home Hub
tagline: Wire up devices with callbacks, interfaces and the observer pattern.
pitch: You are the brain of a house. Describe its devices, give them a contract, pass behaviour around as functions, then let a real event bus tie sensors, lights, locks and a thermostat together. By the end, rules like "motion after sunset turns the hall light on" run on code you wrote, and an automation panel shows which rule fired and why.
controls: Click a room to walk there
Click a device to inspect it
Drag the clock to change the hour

chapters.title: Blueprint
